choose.when: CAST(article_id AS CHAR) AS targetId,action AS kind

mapper.update: UPDATE maintenance_cursor SET next_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE kind=#{kind} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND next_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT kind,last_id AS lastId,scanned,repaired,last_error AS error,next_at AS nextAt,last_finished_at AS finishedAt,(lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AS running FROM maintenance_cursor ORDER BY kind
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending,COALESCE(MAX(attempts),0) AS maxAttempts FROM article_view_sync
SELECT status,COUNT(*) AS count FROM agent_run WHERE created_at>=TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,-1,NOW(6)) GROUP BY status
SELECT status,COUNT(*) AS count,COALESCE(MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,created_at,UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))),0) AS oldestSeconds FROM GROUP BY status

SELECT job_id AS jobId,,status,attempts,available_at AS availableAt,updated_at AS updatedAt,CASE WHEN last_error REGEXP '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,128}$' THEN last_error ELSE 'task_failed' END AS error FROM ORDER BY updated_at DESC,job_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT run_id AS runId,CAST(user_id AS CHAR) AS userId,CAST(conversation_id AS CHAR) AS conversationId,status,DATE_FORMAT(TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,-TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,UTC_TIMESTAMP(),NOW()),created_at),'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%sZ') AS createdAt,updated_at AS updatedAt,deadline FROM agent_run ORDER BY created_at DESC,run_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT status,article_id AS target_iduser_id AS target_id,kind FROM WHERE job_id=#{jobId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE SET status='pending',attempts=0,lease_until=NULL,lease_token=NULL,last_error=NULL,available_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE job_id=#{jobId} AND status='dead'
